title: Vera autonomous sends stay held until the owner date in code, not only behind an admin toggle

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: the owner rule 'Vera drafts, rules send; autonomous sends held to Feb 2027' (2026-11-13) is written nowhere in code or docs. platform_flags.vera_autonomy_enabled (off in production) is the only hold, so one admin toggle opens autonomous sends. The plan cited at lib/lifecycle/registry.ts:4 (email/COACH-EMAIL-SYSTEM-BUILD-PLAN-2026-11-13.md) is not in the repo. Fix: an AUTONOMY_NOT_BEFORE date that isAutonomyEnabled checks beside the flag, and point the registry comment at the doc's real home.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
